subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Reject as invalid, especially by legal procedure
solution: The correct answer is **'Quash'.** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** __ • ** **Let us understand the meaning of the marked option: • **Quash - **to say that an officially decision is no longer true or legal.(यह कहना कि आधिकारिक तौर पर लिया गया निर्णय अब सत्य या कानूनी नहीं है) • **Example - **They moved to **quash** the indictment on which he was brought to trial. Therefore the correct answer is** 'Quash'.** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** • ** **Let us understand the meanings of the other given options; • **Reiterate -** to say something again, once or several times. (किसी बात को दोबारा, एक बार या कई बार कहना) • **Putrid -** smelling bad after being dead (used about dead animals and plants) for sometime. (कुछ समय तक मृत रहने (मृत जानवरों और पौधों के बारे में प्रयुक्त) के बाद दुर्गंध आना) • **Putrefy - **to decay, producing a strong, unpleasant smell. (सड़ना, एक तेज़, अप्रिय गंध पैदा करना) 3c:T99a, The correct answer is **'Melancholic'.**
